Description.value: Thrown gore that pulls a crowd of zombies off your position and holds them there while they eat. Pure XML - no code, no DLL, so it runs with EAC ON and players install nothing. This is the no-code half of Chaotic's Zombie Companion: it lures and holds, but it cannot turn a zombie into a companion and it cannot break a chase that has already started. Install this OR the full mod, never both.
